E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mercedes' birthday gets off to a rocky start. And a chase ensues when Imran finds Lucas in Chester, but things take a dangerous turn...

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
E4Plus1.uk.description: A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister, Rude(ish) Tube, featuring sports of the lawnmower, motorbike and bicycle variety.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
E4Plus1.uk.description: In Leeds, giggly Gemma and Ryan serve up a menu that shows off their fun side. But will it meet Jonathan and Keith's high standards? And will Nigel and Yvonne ever stop singing?

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: J Willy's Bar & Grille: Gordon's got his work cut out at J Willy's in Indiana - most of the food is from a can or the freezer, and they're a million dollars in debt. (S2 Ep12) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Fiesta Sunrise: A cockroach-infested kitchen means that the customers have to leave for their own safety at Fiesta Sunrise, a Mexican restaurant in West Nyack. (S2 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Sushi Ko: Akira and Lisa are losing up to $20,000 a month at their sushi restaurant in California. Can Gordon piece the family back together and save the restaurant? (S3 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Good Cop Bad Dog: Phil and Claire swap parenting roles for the day - Claire will be the fun-loving good cop and Phil the disciplinarian bad cop. (S2 Ep22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: See You Next Fall: The family gather at Jay's before heading to Alex's middle school graduation ceremony. While they're there, Jay tries to hide a Botox mishap from everyone. (S2 Ep23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Friend with Benefit: When Lisa becomes friends with Harper, a new girl at school whose family are extremely wealthy, Homer befriends Harper's father. (S27 Ep6/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lisa with an 'S': Homer loses a large sum of money playing poker with Broadway legend Laney Fontaine, who takes Lisa under her wing and transforms her into a showbiz kid. (S27 Ep7/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Uncut Femmes: Marge gets involved in a jewel heist and learns that there's more to Sarah Wiggum than anyone suspected. (S32 Ep17)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Burger Kings: Mr Burns gets into the plant-based burger business. But Lisa is convinced that he has an ulterior motive. (S32 Ep18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Have a Summer: Adam worries about being hazed by the older students when he goes to high school, but he soon earns their respect by body-slamming Barry. (S3 Ep24)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Breakfast Club: Adam works on a new persona that he hopes will make him seem cool on his first day at high school, while Beverly gets her teaching certificate. (S4 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Leap Day: Cameron's birthday falls on 29 February, and with the celebrations coming but once every four years, there's loads of pressure on Mitchell to get it right. (S3 Ep17)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Last Walt: Claire supports Luke when his friend Walt dies. Phil takes Alex for some father-daughter bonding time, and Haley throws an unauthorised party. (S3 Ep20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Planes, Trains & Cars: The Dunphys want a new car and Phil makes a spontaneous purchase without Claire. Jay is determined to sort his high school reunion with Gloria and Manny. (S3 Ep21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Disneyland: Nothing is more quintessential to good old family fun than a trip to Disneyland - but not without a side of motion sickness, achy feet and a wayward toddler. (S3 Ep22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Great Wife Hope: The male citizens of Springfield become obsessed with the brutal sport of Ultimate Punching, and Marge ends up getting challenged to step into the ring... (S21 Ep3/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Treehouse of Horror XX: Bart and Lisa seek revenge on their teachers. Krusty's latest snack turns Springfield's citizens into zombies. Moe's beer is tainted with Homer's blood. (S21 Ep4/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Devil Wears Nada: Marge becomes famous when she poses for a racy charity calendar. Mr Burns promotes Carl to supervisor. (S21 Ep5/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Pranks and Greens: Bart is determined to seek out the best prankster in Springfield Elementary's history to ask him all about his legendary practical jokes. (S21 Ep6/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: A mystery is unravelled as we journey back in time to when a chance encounter sees two Hollyoaks residents form a love story...

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Defense Rests: Sophia's job gets in the way of her relationship with Peralta. Deputy Chief Wuntch needs Captain Holt's help with a job recommendation. (S2 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: PR exec Claudia, who's 26, looks for a date who won't give her the ick. And 71-year-old music producer Barry dates a former member of a pop group. (S13 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Made in Chelsea
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: After an eventful trip to Dorset, Maali and Sam Prince are giving things a go, but the drama's far from over. Freddy wants to get back with Beks. Jack opens up. (S32 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goggleboxers have been watching Michael McIntyre's The Wheel, Jamie's £1 Wonders, Top Gear, Guillermo del Toro's Cabinet of Curiosities, and Wild Croc Territory. (S20 Ep9)
